messages:
raj (partnerships): Quick sync — AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace listings. Need checklist for initial onboarding: legal, product SKU packaging, staging accounts, and announcement timing. Can folks drop what they need?
marco (product): For product packaging: we should offer 3 SKUs — dev (small), prod (standard), enterprise (reserved). Each SKU needs clear limits (vCPU, GPU class, concurrency) and default quantization profile.
priya (legal): FYI: AWS SaaS contract has a standard addendum we must accept; also get SOC/ISO certs linked. Need to confirm data processing terms for private deployments (bring-your-own-key). @raj share the customer-facing EULA we plan to use.
jen (cloud-pm): For staging: create publisher accounts on each marketplace. We need 1) vendor account, 2) sandbox listing for testing, 3) final listing submission. ETA: publisher creation can take 3-5 business days (varies by cloud).
alice (sales): Also need SKU pricing guidance and committed-usage discounts for Dedicated. Sales will want mapped pricing tiers + clear on-bill metering labels so we can reconcile usage.
marco (product): Quick example SKU CSV we'll upload to marketplaces — keeps them consistent.
```
sku,display_name,cpu,gpu,concurrency,price_per_hour,features
redwood-dev,Dev - 2vCPU,2,none,5,0.05,shared-cache
redwood-prod,Standard - 8vCPU/1xA10,8,A10,50,0.45,prefix-caching
redwood-enterprise,Enterprise - reserved GPUs,16,A100,500,2.50,dedicated-pool+slas
```
priya (legal): That CSV is helpful. Ensure the product descriptions avoid absolute uptime promises outside SLAs. Add a little note to each listing about data residency options.
tom (infra): For support/ops sections on listings, include rate-limited contact emails and our incident SLA summary. We'll need to add integration docs link that explains routing/fallback behavior. Also confirm telemetry opt-in language.
sara (marketing): We'll supply co-brand assets and a one-pager for marketplace store pages. Suggest we lock the messaging by next Tue so I can produce the banners and 40s explainer video for each cloud tile.
raj (partnerships): Timeline proposal: this week - legal + product finalize artifacts; next week - publisher account creation + staging uploads; week after - submit final listings; aim for joint announcement 3 weeks after submission (to allow reviews). Thoughts?
jen (cloud-pm): Sounds reasonable. Note: Azure requires a manifest and can flag image licensing; GCP wants an integration test for billing. I can draft a per-cloud checklist.
alice (sales): For enterprise SKU, include contact form that maps to AE queue. Also request marketplace lead webhook so our CRM gets those leads.
priya (legal): I'll prepare a short addendum template for BYOK/Private + MSA redline highlights. Will post to this thread when ready.
onboard-bot: onboarding-ticket #893 created: marketplace-listing-aws-gcp-azure. Owners: @raj @jen @marco. Due 1769800000.
marco (product): I'll upload the sample CSV + README to the staging bucket and share links here once done.
raj (partnerships): Perfect. If anyone has blocking constraints (e.g., cert timelines, legal redlines, brand approvals), call them out now. Otherwise we'll reconvene Tue 10am PT to finalize messaging. :thumbsup:
jen (cloud-pm): One more note — pricing support: some clouds only accept USD rates; we need to supply currency mapping table. Adding to my checklist.
priya (legal): Also add DMCA/contact points for takedown in the listing metadata.
sara (marketing): I'll draft two headline variants (engineering-first vs enterprise-compliance) and post examples for vote.
tom (infra): Will confirm telemetry endpoints are safe for marketplace network policies and provide stub logs for the listing pages.
raj (partnerships): Awesome — thanks everyone. See you Tue 10am PT.
